args.root_cause: StatsCache config (plugins/StatsCache/config.yml) was changed to retain-history: true at 06:32:52. After that, heap climbed from ~350MB to ~721/768MB, and the server then went down (likely out of memory).
args.actions: Watched status and saw the heap spike. Read the logs and found the StatsCache config reload with retain-history=true. Declared the incident. Rewrote the config with retain-history: false. The server then turned out to be DOWN, so a console reload was impossible and I started it. After the restart, the heap stayed at 340-450MB, TPS returned to 20, and both players rejoined.
args.residual_risk: I did not find out who or what set retain-history to true, so it could be set again. I did not confirm that the server crash was an OOM. The crash and restart disconnected the players briefly. Any in-memory stats history from before the crash was lost. StatsCache has no bound on history growth when retain-history is true.
